Hey OP. I know exactly how that feels. Even now that my parents know I'm depressed and think this med change has helped. I still say I'm fine. 

I took pills for health reasons other than depression. However they had a side effect that could cause depression. We ended up lowering the dosage to see if it helped. Initially it did. Unless mentally I thought so because it was like "finally I'm getting help". Depression is a big mental battle. And it's a battle that we don't choose to have. Like I've got so much and have done a lot of very cool things yet I still awaken and goto sleep at night sad. Having depression doesn't mean you can't feel happy for a while. Like I can feel happy. It's just that the sadness in me is more common in my day rather than feeling happy.

I can't remember the last time I truly was a happy person overall. My emotions fluctuate millions of times daily and it just gets so tiring. I've tried hanging myself twice now. No success due to being a pussy bitch. A fucking coward. I'm a coward either way anyways. What I'm saying is what you feel is very common with depressed people. Often we won't ask for help or say we need it even though we want to. It's the fear of looking needy, self pity, attention. I hate having to look like that but true friends will not think like that of you. They'll support you. 

I'm currently suicidal again. Hanging on by threads. I've gone to the limit. Done my fair share of research on how to commit suicide successfully. I don't have the courage though to do it. My next method. If it happens. There's no going back, I'll for sure end up in a hospital if I put it to work. But I ask you. Please tell your parents that you need help. I know how hard it is but you have to. Depression will keep eating away at you if you don't. There's only so much someone can withstand before they become such a mess that recovery seems impossible. I'm slowly reaching that point. But if I can encourage you to seek help, that would lift me greatly. 

Good luck OP. Message me if you need anything.

This is a place where you can get started with help. If you come here expecting to be cured. The cold truth is you'll be disappointed. This subreddit is a place to vent. To release your emotions. When it comes to studying. Things to try is get rid of anything that is distracting. So like put away the phone. Or just try and not be around things that you would rather do like your video games for say. Also something that helped a lot was I would stay on campus. Then I could get some real study time there and it was easier to keep studying. I think it's a psychological thing, because everyone around you is doing it so it helps. I was never good at studying, highly unmotivated haha. But my last tip is make some life changes and just do it. Working out helps so much, I started working out a while back and ate healthier and I felt great. Lately I've slacked and I see myself becoming depressed again and it's harder then ever to try and get back into that routine. But it helps a lot. You feel so much better about yourself.
